## Compile QSIPrep QC outputs single site
Compiles sub-NN_ses-NN_dir-AP_space-ACPC_desc-image_qc.tsv outputs from all subjects within a single site.
Outputs compiled .csv file within derivatives/qsiprep folder.
Also saves full combined QC output across all sites within parent directory

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# Define parent path and sites
base_path <- "/Volumes/LaCie/Projects/elgan_dti/data"
sites <- c("site-120", "site-130", "site-140", "site-150", "site-160",
           "site-170", "site-220", "site-230", "site-310", "site-320", "site-330")
#sites<-c("PING")

# Build qsiprep paths
qsiprep_paths <- file.path(base_path, sites, "derivatives", "qsiprep")
names(qsiprep_paths) <- sites

# Read, save per-site, and combine
qc_combined <- qsiprep_paths |>
  imap(\(p, site) {
    if (!dir.exists(p)) {
      warning(paste("Directory not found:", p))
      return(NULL)
    }
    
    # Find and read all QC files for this site
    qc_files <- list.files(p, pattern = "image_qc\\.tsv$", recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)
    
    if (length(qc_files) == 0) {
      warning(paste("No QC files found in:", p))
      return(NULL)
    }
    
    site_qc <- qc_files |>
      map(\(f) read_tsv(f, show_col_types = FALSE)) |>
      list_rbind() |>
      rename(subjectID = subject_id, sessionID = session_id) |>
      select(subjectID, sessionID, everything())
    
    # Save per-site CSV
    write_csv(site_qc, file.path(p, "qc_combined.csv"))
    message("Saved per-site QC for ", site)
    
    site_qc
  }) |>
  compact() |>
  list_rbind()

# Preview
glimpse(qc_combined)

# Save full combined CSV to parent directory
write_csv(qc_combined, file.path(base_path, "qsiprep_qc_combined.csv"))
message("Saved full combined QC to ", base_path)
```
